title: Discovery of anti-colon cancer agents targeting wild-type and mutant p53 using computer-aided drug design.
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算机辅助药物设计（QSAR、对接、MD）靶向p53蛋白开发抗癌化合物，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为小分子药物与p53蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Mutations in the p53 gene are common and occur in over 50% of all cancers, as it is involved in DNA damage repair, cell cycle regulation and apoptosis. Moreover, the p53 gene is mutated in 70% of colon cancers. Therefore, the development of drugs to combat this mutation requires urgent attention. With this in mind, in silico drug design approaches were applied on quinoline derivatives with anticancer activity. In 3D-QSAR study, steric, electrostatic, hydrophobic and H-bond acceptor fields (SEHA) play an important role in prediction and design of new colon cancer compounds. Indeed, the two best CoMSIA/SEHA models with (Q(2) = 0.737, R(2) = 0.914, Rpred2 = 0.720) and (Q(2) = 0.738, R(2) = 0.919, Rpred2= 0.739) show good prediction of human colon carcinoma HCT 116 (p53(+/+)) and (p53(-/-)) activities, respectively. Furthermore, the predictive ability and robustness of these models were tested by several validation methods. Molecular docking analyses reveal crucial interactions with the active sites of the p53 protein in both wild type and mutant. Based on these theoretical studies, we designed 10 new compounds with good anticancer activity potential, which were evaluated using ADMET properties. Molecular dynamics simulations were performed to confirm the detailed binding mode of the docking results. Finally, the MM-GBSA based on molecular dynamics simulation confirmed that the designed compounds were able to form stable hydrogen bonding interactions with the crucial residues, which are essential to overcome the p53 mutation in colon cancer.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: p53基因突变常见，存在于超过50%的所有癌症中，因为它参与DNA损伤修复、细胞周期调控和凋亡。此外，p53基因在70%的结肠癌中发生突变。因此，开发对抗这种突变的药物亟需关注。鉴于此，对具有抗癌活性的喹啉衍生物应用了计算机模拟药物设计方法。在3D-QSAR研究中，立体场、静电场、疏水场和氢键受体场（SEHA）在预测和设计新的结肠癌化合物中发挥重要作用。确实，两个最佳的CoMSIA/SEHA模型，分别具有（Q(2) = 0.737, R(2) = 0.914, Rpred2 = 0.720）和（Q(2) = 0.738, R(2) = 0.919, Rpred2 = 0.739），显示出对人类结肠癌HCT 116（p53(+/+)）和（p53(-/-)）活性的良好预测。此外，这些模型的预测能力和稳健性通过多种验证方法进行了测试。分子对接分析揭示了与野生型和突变型p53蛋白活性位点的关键相互作用。基于这些理论研究，我们设计了10种具有良好抗癌活性潜力的新化合物，并使用ADMET性质进行了评估。进行了分子动力学模拟以确认对接结果的详细结合模式。最后，基于分子动力学模拟的MM-GBSA确认，所设计的化合物能够与关键残基形成稳定的氢键相互作用，这对于克服结肠癌中的p53突变至关重要。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
